Are you searching for dependable, punctual, and comfortable Travels in Chitlapakkam? Beautifully nestled between Chrompet, Sanatorium, Tambaram Sanatorium, and Selaiyur in South Chennai—and famous for the serene Chitlapakkam Lake and tranquil residential avenues—Chitlapakkam is one of Chennai's most sought-after peaceful residential suburbs. At SR Tours & Travels, located just minutes away in South Chennai, we provide premier chauffeur-driven car rentals, family SUVs, and spacious Tempo Travellers tailored for stress-free daily commutes, 24/7 airport transfers, wedding party shuttles, and relaxing outstation holiday tours.

Why Choose SR Tours for Travels in Chitlapakkam?

Chitlapakkam connects directly to GST Road (NH 45) via Chrompet and to Velachery Main Road via Selaiyur. Whether you require an early morning flight drop, transportation for elders attending medical consultations in Chrompet or MEPZ, or group transport for a temple pilgrimage, having a dedicated private chauffeur eliminates app surge rates and sudden driver cancellations. When booking our Travels in Chitlapakkam service, you enjoy distinct advantages:

  • 100% On-Time Guarantee: Punctual 24/7 doorstep pickup across Chitlapakkam Main Road, Lake Road, Sethunarayanan Street, Babu Street, and Sanatorium border.
  • Spotlessly Clean, Air-Conditioned Fleet: Immaculate vehicle interiors, powerful climate control, spacious luggage boot space, and active GPS monitoring on every trip.
  • Courteous, Verified Highway Specialists: Background-verified drivers who know traffic flow patterns across GST Road, Chrompet flyover, and interstate highways.
  • Transparent, Flat Billing: Clear hourly packages and per-km outstation tariffs with zero hidden extras, zero midnight surge pricing, and receipt-backed tolls.
  • 24/7 Dedicated Support: Round-the-clock booking assistance via phone, WhatsApp, and online enquiry.

Exploring cab services in surrounding neighbourhoods? Browse our comprehensive guide on travels in Chennai services covering all major South Chennai localities.

Our Diverse Vehicle Fleet in Chitlapakkam

From practical city sedans to spacious 7-seater Innova Crystas and 18-seater tourist Tempo Travellers, our Chitlapakkam fleet caters to every travel requirement:

Popular Travel Services Across Chitlapakkam

1. 24/7 Chennai International Airport (MAA) Transfers

Chitlapakkam is located just 8 to 10 km from Chennai Airport. Enjoy swift transfers via GST Road elevated flyovers or 200-Feet Radial Road in just 15 to 20 minutes. Enjoy doorstep pickup, real-time flight tracking, luggage loading assistance, and zero late-night surge pricing.

2. Chrompet & Tambaram Sanatorium Railway Transfers

Located right next to Chrompet Railway Station and Tambaram Sanatorium, we offer seamless 24/7 suburban and express train connectivity with driver meet-and-greet support and luggage assistance.

3. Wedding & Kalyana Mandapam Transportation

Chitlapakkam, Chrompet, and Selaiyur house renowned marriage halls and convention centers. We provide synchronized fleets of spotless white Innova Crystas and AC Tempo Travellers to ferry guests punctually.

Top Outstation Express Routes from Chitlapakkam

With immediate access to GST Road (NH 45), 200-Feet Radial Road, and Outer Ring Road (ORR), Travels in Chitlapakkam lets you start outstation trips smoothly:

  • Chitlapakkam to Tirupati Balaji Darshan: Swift connection via Bypass / 200-Ft Radial Road to NH 716 for same-day VIP Balaji darshan with our dedicated Tirupati Tour Packages.
  • Chitlapakkam to Mahabalipuram & Pondicherry: Direct drive via Medavakkam and ECR. Explore French heritage cafes and serene beaches with our Pondicherry Tours and Mahabalipuram Tours.
  • Chitlapakkam to Kanchipuram & Vellore: Smooth expressway transit via NH 48 for silk shopping and Golden Temple visits with our Kanchipuram Tour Packages.
  • Chitlapakkam to Trichy, Madurai & Rameswaram: Seamless southern highway cruise straight onto the 6-lane GST national expressway with our Rameswaram Tour Packages.

Smart Booking Tips for Chitlapakkam Residents

  • Plan Around Chrompet Flyover Traffic: The Chrompet-GST junction sees heavy commuter traffic during morning and evening rush hours. Schedule airport and outstation departures 15 minutes earlier.
  • Adequate Luggage Space: For airport drops with multiple international bags or long outstation trips, an Innova Crysta or Tempo Traveller ensures total passenger comfort without cabin clutter.
  • Specify Landmark Details: Mentioning landmarks such as Chitlapakkam Lake Park, Post Office, Sethunarayanan Street, or Muthumariamman Temple helps your chauffeur arrive at your doorstep with zero delay.

Yes, we provide both round-trip and one-way outstation cabs from Chitlapakkam to Bangalore, Tirupati, Pondicherry, Vellore, Trichy, Salem, and Coimbatore.
